ignore_openings.note: possible closed flush door (dark full-height panel), no laser evidence

method: dataprep/room_gt.py: laser stations inside the captured room, sharpest-histogram yaw, floor/ceiling = strongest horizontal planes, each main wall = strongest range^2-weighted plane in a manually chosen window (W:-0.80:-0.68,E:3.79:3.89,S:-0.84:-0.74,N:2.44:2.54)
note: Rectangular room. South side: a 1.2 m box projects 21 cm (26 % of the side) - below the 40 % rule, so the main face y -0.79 is used.
openings_method: dataprep/openings_gt.py: openings marked roughly on laser elevation images by a person, edges snapped to the laser wall (50 % solid-share crossing, 1 cm columns)
